environment.host: local fixture harness; workflow imports run in pinned n8n container

evidenceLabels.verified_static: Export wiring, credential references, graph and local validation inspected without provider traffic.
evidenceLabels.mocked_contract: Exported Code nodes executed against synthetic response fixtures; no external account was contacted.
evidenceLabels.external_unverified: Requires user-owned endpoint or provider credential and a controlled redacted smoke test.
evidenceLabels.unsupported_default: Disabled in the starter-kit default profile until separate evidence and contract work exist.

credentialGaps: real HTTPS Base URL and Bearer credential
actual /models response shape or confirmed absence
manual model availability and provider error semantics
user folder, service-account role and API key
model URI visible to the configured folder
account quota and model-specific native schema behavior
authorization key, contract scope and matching API base
trusted Russian CA chain inside the n8n container
OAuth rate and live 401 refresh behavior under real concurrency

liteLlm.reason: The three MVP paths work through reusable n8n workflows without a proxy, and no measured routing, failover or compatibility gap justifies another service, secret boundary or operations surface. Adding LiteLLM later requires measured evidence and a new ADR.
